extracted.intended_audience: potential attendees / patrons of the Laugh Factory (live comedy audience)
extracted.subtask_description: A venue schedule and promotional copy listing recurring comedy shows, dates/times, featured hosts/lineups, and front-of-house attendance rules for the Laugh Factory. Includes event blurbs and ticketing/entry policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prices, performers, and schedule are subject to change
rubrics_metrics.description: Prices, performers, and schedule are subject to change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated notice across all event listings indicating that advertised ticket prices, the listed performers, and show schedule may be changed without prior notice. Implies that customers should confirm details at purchase/time of attendance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-drink minimum purchase requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: A two-drink minimum purchase per patron is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a per-patron house policy enforced at the venue (applies to all listed shows). Patrons must purchase at least two drinks each; likely enforced by staff at the door or during service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vouchers not redeemable at the door
rubrics_metrics.description: Vouchers are not redeemable at the door.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ticket vouchers (presumably pre-purchased or promotional) cannot be exchanged for entry at the venue's door; customers must follow the venue's voucher redemption process (e.g., online or box office) rather than arriving with a voucher for immediate entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event-specific content policy: 'no topics are off-limits'
rubrics_metrics.description: Here, no topics are off-limits, and the only rule is to have a good time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated for the 'No Fuks Given' comedy jam — a promotional content guideline indicating the show permits unrestricted comedic subject matter. This signals an intentionally permissive editorial boundary for performers and audiences, and that the event embraces edgy/unfiltered material; also emphasizes an overall aim of audience enjoyment as the primary rule.
